# <span id="aanchor77"></span> Data Archive Solution

This feature requires the **Data Archive** add-on and **Application Process – Data Archive** privileges.

The Data Archive solution allows for automated archival of data from a production database to an archive database, and the subsequent automated purge of archived data, following user-configured time spans. Options to manually restore, re-archive, and purge data are also available. FLOWCAL can run against the archival database in read-only mode for the purpose of running reports and viewing data.

An archive database consists of only four tables (FC_ARCHIVE_FLAG, FC_FFLCN_HOURLY, FC_FFMTR_HOURLY, and FC_METER_PERIODIC_VALUES). If custom columns are added to any of these tables, in either the production or archive database, or if columns or constraints are otherwise modified, the changes must be applied to both databases, or the archive service will fail.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Setup">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Setup</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Setup">

<div class="procedure">

To set up an archive database and link it to a production database:

1.  Create a new database shell.
2.  Go to the **\Setup\FcArchival** directory in the FLOWCAL installation folder.
3.  Run the **archiveCreateDb.sql** script on the new archive database to create necessary tablespaces.
4.  Run the **CreateArchToProdDbLink.sql** script on the archive database to create a database link to the production database.
5.  Run the **CreateProdToArchDbLink.sql** script on the production database to create a database link to the archive database.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Service Install">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Data Archive Service Installation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Service Install">

Meter periodic data (FC_METER_PERIODIC_VALUES), final form meter hourly (FC_FFMTR_HOURLY), and final form location hourly (FC_FFLCN_HOURLY) data are transferred from the production database using the installed Data Archive service (FlowCal.Archival.Service.exe). The service also processes data restore, re-archive, and manual purge operations.

<div class="procedure">

To install the Archive service:

1.  Make sure you have the appropriate permissions required to install services on the applicable server.
2.  Go to the **\FlowCal.Archival.Service** directory in the FLOWCAL installation folder.
3.  Right-click the **\_Install_Service.bat** file and select **Run as Administrator**.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Configuration">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Configuration</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Configuration">

Once the databases are linked and service is installed and running, configure and enable the service through the Settings Manager.

<div class="procedure">

1.  Configure the Data Archive operations settings (see: [Data Archive Configuration](Data%20Archive%20Configuration.md)).
2.  Enable archive operations for desired meters and locations (see: [Data Archive Per Device Configuration](Data%20Archive%20Per%20Device%20Configuration.md)).

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="View Data">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />View Archived Data</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="View Data">

Once data has been archived based on the defined time span, you can view the archived data in the Volume Editor and Rollup Viewers by logging into the FLOWCAL archive database.

You will access the archive database using your production database login credentials; however, to log on to the archive database for the first time, you will need to go through the password reset process.

When an object is deleted, its associated archived data will be deleted as well.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Manual Ops">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Manual Restore/Re-archive/Purge</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Manual Ops">

To view the archive history of an object, go to the [Data Archive Per Device Configuration](Data%20Archive%20Per%20Device%20Configuration.md) screen and click the **History** tab. This tab also allows users to manually restore, re-archive, and purge eligible data.

The Toolbox purge cannot be used for an object if the selected measurement month contains archived data; the archived data must first be restored.

</div>
